comment: * Helper for building selection clauses for {@link SQLiteDatabase}. Each * appended clause is combined using {@code AND}. This class is not * thread safe. * * @hide

methods.name: public SelectionBuilder reset()
methods.comment: * Reset any internal state, allowing this builder to be recycled.

methods.name: public SelectionBuilder append(String selection, Object... selectionArgs)
methods.comment:
* Append the given selection clause to the internal state. Each clause is
     * surrounded with parenthesis and combined using {@code AND}.

methods.name: public String getSelection()
methods.comment:
* Return selection string for current internal state.
     *
     * @see #getSelectionArgs()

methods.name: public String[] getSelectionArgs()
methods.comment:
* Return selection arguments for current internal state.
     *
     * @see #getSelection()

methods.name: public Cursor query(SQLiteDatabase db, String table, String[] columns, String orderBy)
methods.comment:
* Execute query using the current internal state as {@code WHERE} clause.
     * Missing arguments as treated as {@code null}.

methods.name: public Cursor query(SQLiteDatabase db, String table, String[] columns, String groupBy, String having, String orderBy, String limit)
methods.comment: * Execute query using the current internal state as {@code WHERE} clause.

methods.name: public int update(SQLiteDatabase db, String table, ContentValues values)
methods.comment: * Execute update using the current internal state as {@code WHERE} clause.

methods.name: public int delete(SQLiteDatabase db, String table)
methods.comment: * Execute delete using the current internal state as {@code WHERE} clause.
